$comment: The operations alerts (spec 08 §7.8 group I): switch-changed, a kill switch set or cleared by a person. Fin Admin's switches route (packages/staff, ARCHITECTURE §15.1) writes switch.set or switch.cleared on admin, in the unit that calls ops.set_switch() and records the audit event; one series, so no field of the line becomes a label; the operator's `pnpm fin switch` joins the sources when it is built. The rest of group I comes with the lines that feed it.

alerts.name: switch-changed
alerts.incident_cause: A person set or cleared a kill switch from Fin Admin: the work it names stops or starts again. Changes: {{value}}.

metadata.check: Who and why: the switch.set or switch.cleared event in the staff audit log (actor, the switch as target, reasonCode), and the line's switch, reasonCode and staffId.
